title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (6/20): Youth in School Uniforms
note_en: 上 after a verb can mark the start of a new, lasting state: 男生悄悄喜欢上了班里的女生 "the boy secretly fell for a girl in his class." 喜欢 alone is "like"; 喜欢上 is "come to like, fall for." English often needs a different verb for this ("fall for," "get into"), while Chinese just adds 上 to the same verb, as in 爱上 "fall in love with."
